en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined promenade with an ornate metal railing overlooking a cityscape. Elegant late‑19th‑century buildings stand on the right, with hills visible in the background. At the top, printed in red, is the caption identifying the location as Budapest's Bástya sétány (Basteipromenade). Small figures stroll along the promenade. A small red number is printed vertically on the right edge.
